notes.title: Version 1.5 live!
notes.notes: Hi all, this is just a small update with a combination of bugfixes and changes to the first couple levels to help new players out. Hopefully this will make it easier for people to get into the game.

notes.title: Version 1.3 - Video settings update!
notes.notes:
Hi all, Here's a patch to expand the graphical options in the "Video Settings" menu.

Firstly, the resolution selector has been changed to a drop down so you can just select the intended resolution instead of needing to scroll through them individually.

Next a slew of options to help increase performance, they're mostly self explanatory (they're made so you can change them without needing to restart, so you can experiment) but to go through them:

Background - enables/disables rendering the background tiles
Ambient Occlusion - enables/disables ambient occlusion (darkening in corners)
Depth of Field - enables/disables the blurring mostly seen at the end of the level and in cutscenes
Simple Spiders - replaces the normal animated spider swarm, and replaces it with a simple 2d version

Outside of Depth of Field, personally I would consider lowering the resolution first before touching any of these, especially on 4k displays. That said, hopefully with these you can tune the experience to your liking and get the game working on more hardware.

If you run into issues with any of these options, please let me know so I can fix them.

notes.title: Update 1.2.2 is live! Cloud Saves! Achivevements!
notes.notes:
Welcome to patch 1.2.2!

This patch has some QOL improvements, and a couple bug fixes.

First big feature is achievements! Simply load the game and it should pop all the achievements you've earned up to that point.

Next is Cloud saves! They should work. I've found cloud saves can be finicky on steam deck, enabling and disabling cloud saves can help. if you're having issues, please visit the discussions.

Now for bug fixes:
- Made the animation for spinning into a grab less stretchy/awkward.
- Fixed the final animation so all guns are present
- Fixed the text to say "Until" instead of "Unitl"

Please let me know if you encounter any more issues in the discussions. I've got some more QOL changes which I plan to implement in the coming days, and intend to do a content update before EOY.

notes.title: Endure The Swarm pits your sokoban skills against endless, horrible insects
notes.notes:
Endure The Swarm, which launches on Friday 8th December, takes that most abstract and respectable of game genres, the block-pushing puzzler, and fills it with ghastly, flesh-eating insects. There’s no amount of pesticide that can stay this tide, nor (sadly) is there the option to stand on a chair screaming and waving a broom. Rather, you must call upon your mammalian mastery of spatial reasoning to survive. The insect hivemind, you see, is incapable of grasping the complexities of block positioning.
